name: Elastic command
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. NEW Perry website hero, single finished landscape 1536x1024. Attached image is a STYLE REFERENCE for saturated cobalt, imperfect ivory ink and the two-eye stickman, not a layout to copy. Push its graphic scale and tension much further. Think audacious experimental screenprint campaign that has become a playable website.
ELASTIC COMMAND: an enormous ivory Mac Command glyph is stretched like an elastic slingshot across the page. Three rounded loops are gigantic, aggressively cropped beyond TOP and LEFT viewport edges. The fourth loop stretches into two long taut ivory strokes converging near x1300 y700, producing a spectacular diagonal across the full page. At that convergence the tiny ivory outline Perry (110px tall, circular head, TWO oval eyes, no mouth, spare limbs) leans all the way backward, heels dug in, pulling the loop with both hands. A vivid LEMON-YELLOW ordinary computer cursor sits nestled in the stretched loop like a projectile about to be released into a website demo. This is playful tension, no weapons or violence, just a familiar Mac symbol behaving impossibly. Flat dry-ink graphic, NO real rubber, 3D, volume, gradients or keycap.
Cobalt fills every pixel behind the art. Vast empty triangular cobalt space at upper-right balances massive cropped loops at left. In that space print the headline 'go.\nfor.\nit.' stacked vertically, in shockingly large YELLOW BRUSH LETTERING, very controlled beautiful custom lettering, three short rhythmic lines, NOT sans typography or centered script pasted over glyph. Text nearly touches top margin and the stretched strokes but never becomes unreadable. Tiny handwritten 'a little further…' just above Perry's hands, white, very small.
Navigation is unusually spare: tiny white 'perry' upper-left in a patch of clear cobalt; top-right clear white 'Get Perry for Mac ↗'. No top navigation menu. At bottom left, 24px ivory exact product promise 'Your Mac. A little less on you.' with 17px 'Ask, learn, or hand the task to Perry.' At the cursor's end, one small white outlined target and text 'Pull to meet Perry' makes the actual interaction obvious; below it small clickable fallback text 'or tap to try →'. The interaction target takes the place of a generic pill CTA. Include a tiny theme icon near the acquisition link.
Graphically fearless scale, full-bleed confident color, precise tension and negative space, one cursor, one mascot, one enormous warped glyph. No screenshots, cards, footer bar, centered layout, generic feature labels, shadows, cute stationery, clouds, smiling faces, decorative sparkles. Make this an unforgettable character-driven graphic encounter. The frame should feel barely big enough to contain the gesture.

name: Inkbreaker
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one NEW radical 1536x1024 landscape website hero for Perry. Supplied image is reference ONLY for hand-drawn ink, tiny two-eyed character and untangling metaphor. Do not copy its cloud-over-headline layout. This version is a visceral full-frame graphic composition, a collision between incredible line density and immaculate empty paper.
INKBREAKER: a vast BLACK RECTANGULAR FIELD of thousands of fine, intricately woven hand-ink loops occupies the left 65 percent of viewport, bleeding beyond the left, top and bottom edges. It feels like a dense pen plotter tapestry of tangled linework, architecturally controlled and beautiful, NOT a cloud, smoke, neurons, brain, scribble blob or photo. At its right edge, the intricate black web narrows violently into ONE coral ring held by tiny Perry at x1030 y530. Perry is a black outline stickman with big unfilled round head, TWO upright eyes, no mouth, only 120px tall. He has planted his feet against the boundary and pulls ONE loose ink thread through the coral ring with both hands. On the right 35 percent, extraordinary white negative space opens up. The released thread flows into beautifully fluid black custom handwritten 'got\nyou.' spanning that clear space, with the y descender extending down to a small ordinary coral cursor near bottom-right. The typography is LITERALLY made from the line emerging from the tangle, and the transition must be visually convincing. The dense field is partly hollowed at Perry's position, making a white wedge of relief spreading backwards into it. No explanatory arrows or multiple connecting lines.
The tiny white lowercase 'perry' wordmark is printed directly into a clear reserved black patch at top-left. Small white product text embedded near bottom-left on a black clear reserve: 'The companion that helps your Mac make sense.' A small black 'Get Perry for Mac ↗' sits upper-right on WHITE. Under 'got you.' a small clean functional invitation reads 'Give me something to untangle →', linked to the coral cursor as the primary action, and 15px 'Try a website demo'. No rounded button rectangle, no conventional footer strip. Tiny sun/moon icon near top-right.
The visual personality must be brave, intimate and exceptionally crafted. Monochrome with ONE hot coral ring/cursor. White area stays calm and welcoming, character eager and helpful. Use density contrast and line precision, not ornamental props. Do NOT add app screenshots, cards, a second mascot, cartoon faces in the tangle, gloomy wash, grayscale gradient, paper grain everywhere, fake metrics or marketing paragraphs. A complete readable website hero that could also be an iconic print. The stark left/right material contrast is the composition, NOT a copy-left/illustration-right template.

name: Your move
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. NEW finished Perry website hero, landscape 1536x1024. Use the attached favourite ONLY as a reference for confident figure-ground interplay, hand ink and a tiny two-eye companion. Do NOT reuse its white page or bottom copy/CTA arrangement. This is a visually fierce new campaign, not a recolour.
YOUR MOVE: the entire page is a flat intensely saturated VERMILION-ORANGE field. A MONUMENTAL warm-ivory computer cursor arrow, 1400px tall, slices diagonally from beyond bottom-left to beyond top-right, so both its point and tail crop outside the viewport. Its geometry is crisp and instantly identifiable, no 3D, rough ink only microscopically at edge. Across this diagonal ivory pointer, enormous BLACK expressive calligraphic words 'your\nmove.' are written, flowing from x80 y180 to x1400 y800. Lettering extends across the ivory cursor into orange background with exceptional contour balance; black letters remain black and legible on both. The terminal e curves into one long black line that exits the cursor's hard edge at right. A tiny black stick-person Perry is leaning over that edge as if it is the ledge of the page, holding the terminal line and offering a SMALL real-looking ivory cursor to the visitor below. Circular UNFILLED head, TWO vertical black oval eyes, no mouth, spare limbs, 100px tall. Very tiny handwritten 'or mine.' sits beside him. Visually the whole page stages a negotiation of whose turn it is to move. Massive diagonal negative-space geometry, elegant wild lettering and an intimate small exchange.
Interface integrated at unusual positions: small BLACK 'perry' upper-left on orange. Clear BLACK 'Get Perry for Mac ↗' upper-right. A clean 24px two-line product sentence placed inside a quiet part of the ivory arrow tail near lower-left: 'Your Mac.\nAn extra pair of hands.' Under it 17px 'Perry can guide you or take on the task.' Near the small offered cursor on right, two clear understated text actions separated by a short rule: 'Show me' and 'Take over', with tiny label 'Try a website demo'. These two controls are legible and purposeful, native black type on orange, NOT pills or feature cards. Add a tiny theme icon near navigation. Keep 20 percent empty orange breathing room.
This must feel like a punk screenprint executed by an exceptional typographer: scale that ignores polite margins, sharp asymmetry, striking color, beautiful legibility, refined hierarchy and hand-drawn personality. No badges, fake logos, performance numbers, gradients, glossy object, screenshots, app windows, stickers, torn paper, stock script font, splash decorations, radial starbursts, generic hero layout or bottom marketing strip. Exactly one giant arrow, one small cursor, one character, one enormous two-word gesture.

name: The impossible pointer
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Design a NEW astonishing art-directed Perry homepage hero, landscape 1536x1024, a complete finished website screenshot. Attached reference supplies ONLY the dry-ink stroke style, familiar cursor geometry and tiny two-eye mascot; create a wholly different composition.
THE IMPOSSIBLE POINTER: black uncoated paper fills the viewport. An enormous open-outline warm-ivory cursor arrow, approximately 1050px tall and leaning 20 degrees clockwise, occupies the whole frame, with point cropped at top and tail cropped bottom-right. Its outline is an 80px-wide dry-brush band that loops through ITSELF with THREE very precise over/under intersections, forming an elegant impossible continuous route similar to a Penrose construction. The silhouette is still a conventional computer-pointer arrow, not a triangle, Celtic knot, random ribbon or maze. Show flat screenprinted broad bands with extremely subtle graphite edge offsets only where needed to clarify crossing. No photoreal 3D, plastic, bevel, gradients or neon.
Across the open black interior of this enormous pointer, HUGE expressive ivory custom brush script reads 'there’s\na way.' on two lines, around 180px scale, with the swash of the y passing through the arrow outline in an exact figure-ground reversal: the script goes BLACK on the ivory band then returns ivory on black. This creates a second layer of impossible spatial play, keep it exquisite and readable. At the lower-left crossing a tiny coral-red path makes a cheeky straight shortcut between two distant portions of the ivory loop. Tiny ivory ink Perry (110px tall, circular unfilled head, TWO vertical oval eyes, no mouth) steps from one band to the other across this coral shortcut, carrying a small ivory cursor under one arm. One tiny handwritten aside 'found it.' beside him. ONE character only.
Brand and functional UI are restrained but visible: tiny ivory 'perry' upper-left; top-right 'Get Perry for Mac ↗', tiny theme icon. At left bottom in untouched black space, clean 23px ivory promise 'Help with what’s on your Mac.' and 17px 'Ask Perry. Follow a guide. Hand it over.' A small CORAL circular action target at the start of the shortcut, with clear nearby ivory text 'Show me the way →', acts as the hero's interactive invitation. No standard pill button or footer band.
The composition should be mesmerising through coherent geometric surprise and bravura typography, not noisy decoration. Monumental negative space, expertly choreographed three crossings, one shortcut, minute warm character. Like an experimental ink print for a computer tool with a personality. No app screenshots, panels, dashboards, cards, paper books, diagram labels, science fiction portals, stars, fake metrics, repetitive arrows, outer presentation frames. Make the impossible arrow a memorable proprietary graphic device.
